blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: streets and boundaries

items.t: The band is a price filter, not a neighbourhood: it applies across the whole City of Maple Ridge, whose named neighbourhoods run from Port Hammond and Port Haney in the southwest to Webster's Corners, Whonnock and Ruskin in the east.
The City describes Silver Valley, on the north side of the Alouette River, as a gateway to recreation areas, and Albion/Kanaka by the Albion Fairgrounds and Albion Sports Complex.
Maple Ridge is in Metro Vancouver and in School District 42 (SD42), and its hospital, Ridge Meadows Hospital, is at 11666 Laity Street.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: the housing stock

items.t: The band's urban detached stock sits mainly on RS-1 (Single Detached Residential) lots: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, section 605, sets a subdivision minimum of 668.0 square metres lot area, 18.0 metres width and 27.0 metres depth, with 40% maximum lot coverage.
The band also reaches the Town Centre, where the Town Centre Area Plan supports higher densities in a transit-oriented core anchored by the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.
Rural-edge homes in Webster's Corners, Thornhill and Whonnock sit under the City's rural zones rather than RS-1, so lot rules differ by address, not by price band.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: rules that affect buyers

items.t: One secondary suite is allowed per lot, inside the single detached building, at most 40% of gross floor area, and not within the floodplain area.
Eligible single-family and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) bylaws, depending on lot and transit criteria the City states.
Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 covers the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station TOAs.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The Maple Ridge Leisure Centre at 11925 Haney Place holds the indoor pool, fitness centre, gymnasium and sport courts for the Town Centre.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: development and new projects

items.t: Full entry for this page: TransLink's Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) is in detailed planning — 22 kilometres between Willowbrook and Haney Place with peak service every 10 minutes planned; designs, costs and timelines are not yet determined.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: costs and taxes

items.t: Maple Ridge's 2026 tax rate summary lists a total residential mill rate of 4.53578 per $1,000 of assessed value, including school and other authorities.
The City's 2026 budget raises water rates 4.5% and sewer rates 6.05%, separate from the 3.5% property tax increase.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Homes Under $1.8M Topic: getting around

items.t: West Coast Express trains run on weekdays from Port Haney Station, 22300 River Road, and Maple Meadows Station, between Waterfront in downtown Vancouver and Mission City.
The R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus runs from Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place Exchange in the Town Centre.
